posts.text: As the heatwave intensifies, I urge everyone to stay hydrated and carry water. Please check on the elderly and offer water to those in need. Follow NDMA guidelines — avoid going out during peak afternoon hours.
posts.caption: As the heatwave intensifies, I urge everyone to stay hydrated and carry water. Please check on the elderly and offer water to those in need. Follow NDMA guidelines — avoid going out during peak afternoon hours.

posts.text: PM chaired a review meeting on the heatwave situation across India. Directed all states to activate Heat Action Plans and ensure drinking water availability. Special focus on protecting vulnerable populations.
posts.caption: PM chaired a review meeting on the heatwave situation across India. Directed all states to activate Heat Action Plans and ensure drinking water availability. Special focus on protecting vulnerable populations.

posts.text: Never let India’s head bow. Outlined our massive Smart Border plan to strengthen BSF and stop infiltration. We will deploy cutting-edge technology across every inch of our borders. India’s security is non-negotiable.
posts.caption: Never let India’s head bow. Outlined our massive Smart Border plan to strengthen BSF and stop infiltration. We will deploy cutting-edge technology across every inch of our borders. India’s security is non-negotiable.

posts.text: The people of India deserve answers. This government’s trade deals with the US are compromising India’s interests. We will continue to hold them accountable — the fight for India’s sovereignty is far from over.
posts.caption: The people of India deserve answers. This government’s trade deals with the US are compromising India’s interests. We will continue to hold them accountable — the fight for India’s sovereignty is far from over.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh is becoming India’s semiconductor manufacturing hub. Laid the foundation stone today — this will create thousands of jobs for our youth and put UP at the center of India’s digital transformation.
posts.caption: Uttar Pradesh is becoming India’s semiconductor manufacturing hub. Laid the foundation stone today — this will create thousands of jobs for our youth and put UP at the center of India’s digital transformation.

posts.text: Delhi is reeling under extreme heat. Have directed all agencies to ensure water supply and relief measures across the city. Free ORS packets being distributed. Stay safe, Delhi.
posts.caption: Delhi is reeling under extreme heat. Have directed all agencies to ensure water supply and relief measures across the city. Free ORS packets being distributed. Stay safe, Delhi.

posts.text: Productive Quad foreign ministers’ meeting today. Discussed the need for safe, unimpeded maritime commerce across the Indo-Pacific. Four maritime democracies working together for economic resilience and stability.
posts.caption: Productive Quad foreign ministers’ meeting today. Discussed the need for safe, unimpeded maritime commerce across the Indo-Pacific. Four maritime democracies working together for economic resilience and stability.

posts.text: The Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund and Rs 2,000 crore boost for micro enterprises are reviving 200 legacy industrial clusters. Our reform express is on track — simplifying tax, easing customs, streamlining compliance.
posts.caption: The Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund and Rs 2,000 crore boost for micro enterprises are reviving 200 legacy industrial clusters. Our reform express is on track — simplifying tax, easing customs, streamlining compliance.

posts.text: Proud to partner with Reliance on clean energy in Madhya Pradesh. This 500 MW collaboration shows that India’s energy transition is bigger than any single company. Together, we build a greener India.
posts.caption: Proud to partner with Reliance on clean energy in Madhya Pradesh. This 500 MW collaboration shows that India’s energy transition is bigger than any single company. Together, we build a greener India.

posts.text: Reliance is expanding into power and telecom with renewed focus. Our partnership with Adani Group on the MP power project marks a new chapter — clean energy, strategic collaboration, India’s future.
posts.caption: Reliance is expanding into power and telecom with renewed focus. Our partnership with Adani Group on the MP power project marks a new chapter — clean energy, strategic collaboration, India’s future.

posts.text: India’s entrepreneurial spirit continues to inspire me. The young founders I meet remind me that innovation is not about resources — it’s about resilience and vision. Keep building.
posts.caption: India’s entrepreneurial spirit continues to inspire me. The young founders I meet remind me that innovation is not about resources — it’s about resilience and vision. Keep building.

posts.text: Honored to present the Padma Awards today. These awards recognize extraordinary contributions to India — in arts, science, public affairs, and social service. Congratulations to all awardees.
posts.caption: Honored to present the Padma Awards today. These awards recognize extraordinary contributions to India — in arts, science, public affairs, and social service. Congratulations to all awardees.

posts.text: Iran thought they were going to outwait me. They misjudged. I don’t care about the midterms. The Strait is going to be open to everybody — it’s international waters. We’ll watch over it, but nobody’s going to control it.
posts.caption: Iran thought they were going to outwait me. They misjudged. I don’t care about the midterms. The Strait is going to be open to everybody — it’s international waters. We’ll watch over it, but nobody’s going to control it.

posts.text: Continuing to push for economic growth and opportunity. The UK must remain a global leader in AI and technology. Our future depends on the choices we make today.
posts.caption: Continuing to push for economic growth and opportunity. The UK must remain a global leader in AI and technology. Our future depends on the choices we make today.

posts.text: Date night in Cleveland. Let’s go Cavs…all the way back! Ready to fight for Ohio as your next governor. We won 82% in the primary — now let’s bring that energy to November.
posts.caption: Date night in Cleveland. Let’s go Cavs…all the way back! Ready to fight for Ohio as your next governor. We won 82% in the primary — now let’s bring that energy to November.

posts.text: Grateful for the opportunity to serve this country alongside my family. The strength of America lies in its communities and the values we pass to the next generation.
posts.caption: Grateful for the opportunity to serve this country alongside my family. The strength of America lies in its communities and the values we pass to the next generation.

posts.text: Testified before the Senate about the 14 missing January 6 evidence boxes. The American people deserve transparency. We will continue to pursue the truth wherever it leads.
posts.caption: Testified before the Senate about the 14 missing January 6 evidence boxes. The American people deserve transparency. We will continue to pursue the truth wherever it leads.

posts.text: The US is building an American AI stack with $600B in investment. India can leverage this for tools in local languages. Open-source tech and strategic partnerships will be key for both nations.
posts.caption: The US is building an American AI stack with $600B in investment. India can leverage this for tools in local languages. Open-source tech and strategic partnerships will be key for both nations.

posts.text: The World Bank is accelerating climate finance and infrastructure investment in developing nations. We need bold action and real partnerships to close the development gap.
posts.caption: The World Bank is accelerating climate finance and infrastructure investment in developing nations. We need bold action and real partnerships to close the development gap.

posts.text: People have waited a long time for change. I understand the frustration, but we’re turning it around. This Labour government will deliver on its promise to rebuild Britain.
posts.caption: People have waited a long time for change. I understand the frustration, but we’re turning it around. This Labour government will deliver on its promise to rebuild Britain.

posts.text: Met with President Zelenskyy in Rome. Australia stands firmly with Ukraine’s sovereignty. We will continue to provide military aid and push for intensified sanctions against Russia.
posts.caption: Met with President Zelenskyy in Rome. Australia stands firmly with Ukraine’s sovereignty. We will continue to provide military aid and push for intensified sanctions against Russia.

posts.text: Norway will open talks with France on joining our nuclear umbrella. Europe must build its own security architecture — we cannot depend solely on the United States. France is ready to lead.
posts.caption: Norway will open talks with France on joining our nuclear umbrella. Europe must build its own security architecture — we cannot depend solely on the United States. France is ready to lead.

posts.text: Dubai continues to set the standard for innovation and growth. Our vision is clear: build the future today. The UAE welcomes the world’s brightest minds and boldest ideas.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to set the standard for innovation and growth. Our vision is clear: build the future today. The UAE welcomes the world’s brightest minds and boldest ideas.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it’s possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic’s. We won’t leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it’s possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic’s. We won’t leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp.

posts.text: AI is transforming how people connect and create. We’re investing heavily in making AI tools accessible to everyone on our platforms. Meta’s mission hasn’t changed — connecting people, now with AI at the core.
posts.caption: AI is transforming how people connect and create. We’re investing heavily in making AI tools accessible to everyone on our platforms. Meta’s mission hasn’t changed — connecting people, now with AI at the core.

posts.text: Honored to address Stanford’s class of 2026. AI will be the most transformative technology of your lifetime. Your generation has the opportunity to shape it responsibly — lean into the challenge, not away from it.
posts.caption: Honored to address Stanford’s class of 2026. AI will be the most transformative technology of your lifetime. Your generation has the opportunity to shape it responsibly — lean into the challenge, not away from it.

posts.text: 2026 is AI’s usefulness year. We’re moving from models to systems — from hype to real impact. AI should be scaffolding for human potential, not a replacement. That’s the vision driving everything we build at Microsoft.
posts.caption: 2026 is AI’s usefulness year. We’re moving from models to systems — from hype to real impact. AI should be scaffolding for human potential, not a replacement. That’s the vision driving everything we build at Microsoft.

posts.text: I’m delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level, white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. The human part of employment is irreplaceable.
posts.caption: I’m delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level, white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. The human part of employment is irreplaceable.

posts.text: Incredibly proud of our Q2 results — $111.2 billion in revenue and 17% growth. As I transition to Executive Chairman, I’m confident Apple’s best days are ahead. We’re making good progress on a more personalized Siri.
posts.caption: Incredibly proud of our Q2 results — $111.2 billion in revenue and 17% growth. As I transition to Executive Chairman, I’m confident Apple’s best days are ahead. We’re making good progress on a more personalized Siri.

posts.text: Taiwan is booming. Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. This is where the chips come, packaging comes, this is where AI supercomputers were created. We plan to spend $150 billion a year here.
posts.caption: Taiwan is booming. Taiwan is the epicentre of the AI revolution. This is where the chips come, packaging comes, this is where AI supercomputers were created. We plan to spend $150 billion a year here.

posts.text: India’s digital public infrastructure is being studied and replicated globally. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC — we’ve shown that technology can drive financial inclusion at population scale. The next frontier is AI for public good.
posts.caption: India’s digital public infrastructure is being studied and replicated globally. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC — we’ve shown that technology can drive financial inclusion at population scale. The next frontier is AI for public good.

posts.text: I plan to give away $200 billion by 2045. With global aid being cut, philanthropy matters more than ever. Preventable diseases still kill millions — we can change that if we stay committed.
posts.caption: I plan to give away $200 billion by 2045. With global aid being cut, philanthropy matters more than ever. Preventable diseases still kill millions — we can change that if we stay committed.

posts.text: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. Our clients are seeing real ROI from AI-driven automation — not just experimentation, but production-grade transformation at scale.
posts.caption: IBM is doubling down on enterprise AI and hybrid cloud. Our clients are seeing real ROI from AI-driven automation — not just experimentation, but production-grade transformation at scale.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe’s generative AI tools are empowering millions of creators to do more, faster, while keeping human creativity at the center.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they amplify each other. Adobe’s generative AI tools are empowering millions of creators to do more, faster, while keeping human creativity at the center.

posts.text: Building in AI requires patience and conviction. The best products don’t just use AI — they rethink the entire experience around what AI makes possible. Excited about what’s coming next.
posts.caption: Building in AI requires patience and conviction. The best products don’t just use AI — they rethink the entire experience around what AI makes possible. Excited about what’s coming next.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe luxury and sustainability must go hand in hand. Leading with purpose means making bold choices — about materials, supply chains, and the legacy we leave behind.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe luxury and sustainability must go hand in hand. Leading with purpose means making bold choices — about materials, supply chains, and the legacy we leave behind.

posts.text: FedEx is leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. Every package, every route, every delivery — we’re using technology to become smarter, faster, and more sustainable.
posts.caption: FedEx is leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. Every package, every route, every delivery — we’re using technology to become smarter, faster, and more sustainable.

posts.text: Whenever I come back to play, it’s 120%. The breaks help me stay fresh physically and mentally. So proud of this team — RCB in the final again! E sala cup namde!
posts.caption: Whenever I come back to play, it’s 120%. The breaks help me stay fresh physically and mentally. So proud of this team — RCB in the final again! E sala cup namde!

posts.text: IPL season done for MI but the fight continues. Proud of the boys who gave everything this season. Already looking forward to what’s next — plenty of cricket ahead.
posts.caption: IPL season done for MI but the fight continues. Proud of the boys who gave everything this season. Already looking forward to what’s next — plenty of cricket ahead.

posts.text: The body will tell me when it’s time. I’m focused on getting fit and giving it everything if I can. All of Chennai has been amazing — your support means the world.
posts.caption: The body will tell me when it’s time. I’m focused on getting fit and giving it everything if I can. All of Chennai has been amazing — your support means the world.

posts.text: Tough IPL season but I’ve learned to listen to my body. Had a slight niggle coming back from the World Cup. The goal is always to be at my best when it matters most. Process over results.
posts.caption: Tough IPL season but I’ve learned to listen to my body. Had a slight niggle coming back from the World Cup. The goal is always to be at my best when it matters most. Process over results.

posts.text: Five IPL titles and still hungry for more. This team’s legacy is built on passion and hard work. MI will always fight until the last ball. Already looking forward to next season.
posts.caption: Five IPL titles and still hungry for more. This team’s legacy is built on passion and hard work. MI will always fight until the last ball. Already looking forward to next season.

posts.text: What an incredible knock by Vaibhav Sooryavanshi — 97 off 29 balls! At 15, this young man is playing with the composure and technique of a veteran. Outstanding talent, India’s future is bright.
posts.caption: What an incredible knock by Vaibhav Sooryavanshi — 97 off 29 balls! At 15, this young man is playing with the composure and technique of a veteran. Outstanding talent, India’s future is bright.

posts.text: RCB in the IPL final again — Rajat Patidar joining the elite club of captains who’ve led teams to consecutive finals. Indian cricket leadership keeps getting stronger with each generation.
posts.caption: RCB in the IPL final again — Rajat Patidar joining the elite club of captains who’ve led teams to consecutive finals. Indian cricket leadership keeps getting stronger with each generation.

posts.text: IPL 2026 Qualifier 1: Royal Challengers Bengaluru storm into the final with a record 92-run win over Gujarat Titans! 254/5 — the highest total in IPL playoff history. The final awaits on May 31!
posts.caption: IPL 2026 Qualifier 1: Royal Challengers Bengaluru storm into the final with a record 92-run win over Gujarat Titans! 254/5 — the highest total in IPL playoff history. The final awaits on May 31!

posts.text: IPL 2026 delivering absolute drama! RCB set a new playoff record with 254/5 against Gujarat Titans. The final on May 31 promises to be one for the ages.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 delivering absolute drama! RCB set a new playoff record with 254/5 against Gujarat Titans. The final on May 31 promises to be one for the ages.

posts.text: TATA IPL 2026 Qualifier 1 — RCB 254/5 beat GT by 92 runs! Rajat Patidar 93*(33) leads the charge as the defending champions march to the final! See you on May 31 at Ahmedabad! #IPL2026
posts.caption: TATA IPL 2026 Qualifier 1 — RCB 254/5 beat GT by 92 runs! Rajat Patidar 93*(33) leads the charge as the defending champions march to the final! See you on May 31 at Ahmedabad! #IPL2026

posts.text: Training hard and staying focused for what’s ahead. Every throw is a step closer to the goal. Grateful for all the support from India — your energy fuels me on the field.
posts.caption: Training hard and staying focused for what’s ahead. Every throw is a step closer to the goal. Grateful for all the support from India — your energy fuels me on the field.

posts.text: Don’t ignore academics for sport — that’s my honest advice to young athletes. You need both. Education is your safety net, and it makes you a smarter competitor on the court too.
posts.caption: Don’t ignore academics for sport — that’s my honest advice to young athletes. You need both. Education is your safety net, and it makes you a smarter competitor on the court too.

posts.text: Watching the next generation of Indian athletes shine fills my heart. The dedication, the sacrifice — I know what it takes. So proud of where Indian sport is headed. Keep pushing limits.
posts.caption: Watching the next generation of Indian athletes shine fills my heart. The dedication, the sacrifice — I know what it takes. So proud of where Indian sport is headed. Keep pushing limits.

posts.text: Intense start at Norway Chess 2026! A 144-move marathon against Keymer — managed to escape with a draw. Every game at this level pushes you to the edge. Love the challenge.
posts.caption: Intense start at Norway Chess 2026! A 144-move marathon against Keymer — managed to escape with a draw. Every game at this level pushes you to the edge. Love the challenge.

posts.text: Indian football keeps growing. The passion from the fans, the hunger in the young players — this is what drives me. Every match is a chance to inspire the next generation.
posts.caption: Indian football keeps growing. The passion from the fans, the hunger in the young players — this is what drives me. Every match is a chance to inspire the next generation.
